Error Report

Error report using explicit input data. Returns a deterministic result without model calls or task execution.

Signature

error_report(location, symptom, cause=None)

Example input

{
  "location": "auth.spec.ts:42",
  "symptom": "expected 200, got 401"
}

Example output

{
  "location": "auth.spec.ts:42",
  "observation": "expected 200, got 401",
  "cause": "unconfirmed",
  "cause_supported": false
}

Run from repository root

python scripts/solve.py error_report < examples/error-report.json

Limits

Operates only on supplied data. Inspect source for validation and assumptions; this helper cannot establish real-world correctness.
